description: One owner per custom path against the explicitly pinned upstream baseline. Current-main tree distance and graph backlog are reported separately, never presented as custom patch weight.

groups.title: CPU renderer and compositor integration
groups.handling: Adds RT_PIXMAN, pixman textures/framebuffers/elements, renderer selection, GL-free startup/cleanup and diagnostic identification. Includes the failed-begin/end guard and frame-damage tracing.
groups.rationale: The GMA 950 cannot run upstream's GLES 3 renderer. Keep until an upstream CPU backend supports the same target; validate flat-mode rendering, damage, resize, buffer lifetime and GL-path non-regression.

groups.title: Capture protocol without linux-dmabuf
groups.handling: Keeps SHM constraints and guards dmabuf device/modifier access when the linuxDma protocol is absent.
groups.rationale: A software renderer does not advertise dmabuf. Candidate for a standalone upstream fix after protocol tests; this does not prove all screen-sharing clients work.

groups.title: Python 3.11 stub-generator compatibility
groups.handling: Uses assignment type aliases instead of Python 3.12 PEP 695 syntax.
groups.rationale: The i686 builder has Python 3.11. Drop when the build toolchain is upgraded and stub generation is tested, or upstream supports the same baseline.

groups.title: Older libstdc++ truthy helper
groups.handling: Replaces ranges::starts_with with an explicit lowercase string and string_view::starts_with.
groups.rationale: The target libstdc++ lacks the ranges algorithm. Verify truthy semantics and allocation/performance tradeoff before upstreaming; remove after a tested toolchain upgrade.

groups.title: Fork documentation and divergence tooling
groups.handling: Owns only fork documentation, accounting code, and its CI. Kept separate from runtime patch totals.
groups.rationale: Reviewable accounting should not masquerade as renderer code. Keep the reporter aligned with Omarchy's implementation.
